summary: Zoneminder is a closed-circuit television application designed to monitor and manage camera feeds. It provides support for IP, USB, and analog cameras within a self-hosted video surveillance setup.
goodFor: Home users and administrators who need to manage mixed-technology camera hardware using an open-source video surveillance platform.
watchOut: Setting up a reliable surveillance pipeline can require significant configuration effort, particularly when integrating diverse camera types and hardware configurations.
deployNotes: As a PHP application packaged for Debian-based systems, it typically requires a web server, a database backend, and persistent storage for recorded video data.
